# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/rules.mjs, docs/specs/00_foundation/05_defines_and_rules.md). Do not edit; change tools/content/data/game_rules.json.
# on_startup is not run on a country: the story pace is set once for the whole world.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_story_pace option = SLOW } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 1.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_story_pace option = FAST } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 0.75 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
